    bbolt.FLImpl) (a : Loc), I.IsImpl a → I.InitSpec) (hIs :
    bbolt.internal.common.Page.IsFreelistPage.spec) (hIds :
    bbolt.internal.common.Page.FreelistPageIds.spec) : bbolt.internal.freelist.Interface.Read.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.internal.freelist.Interface.Read.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (fli : GoInterface) (p : Loc) (pg : List w8) (dq : DFrac),
    bbolt.pageFlags pg = bbolt.freelistPageFlag →
      16 + 8 * (bbolt.flCountIdx pg).snd + 8 * (bbolt.flCountIdx pg).fst ≤ pg.length →
        (bbolt.flCountIdx pg).fst < 2 ^ 63 →
          (bbolt.flIds pg).Nodup →
            (∀ (x : w64), x ∈ bbolt.flIds pg → 2 ≤ BitVec.toNat x) →
              0 < p.addr →
                p.addr + ↑pg.length ≤ maxAddr →
                  ⊢
                    ∀ Φ,
                      isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt.internal.freelist ∗
                          bbolt.flPgOwn fli bbolt.FLPg.empty ∗ bytesPointsto p dq pg -∗
                        ▷
                            (bbolt.flPgOwn fli (bbolt.FLPg.ofInit (bbolt.flIds pg)) ∗ bytesPointsto p dq pg -∗
                              Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                          WP ((bbolt.ifaceCall fli go!"Read") (intoVal p)) {{ Φ }}

    := own✝, hdl := hdl✝, hdl_persistent := ⋯ }
